summary: Frontend-only SEO regression testing for ashtor.net. Verified robots.txt, sitemap.xml, per-route unique titles/descriptions/canonicals, EN↔ES language switching, admin noindex, footer SEO block, and landing regression (hero, chat widget lazy-load, lead form inputs). All SEO fixes work correctly and nothing regressed.

verifications.robots_txt: PASS — contains 'Disallow: /admin' and 'Sitemap: https://ashtor.net/sitemap.xml' (Cloudflare content-signal block prepended, expected)
verifications.sitemap_xml: PASS — valid XML with exactly 6 <loc> entries for ashtor.net routes
verifications.home_en_meta: PASS — title 'ashtor.net — Remote Tech Recruitment | Connect. Build. Remote.', unique description, canonical=https://ashtor.net/, robots=index,follow, og:title/og:description set, <html lang>=en
verifications.home_es_meta: PASS — after clicking language-toggle-es title becomes 'ashtor.net — Reclutamiento Tech Remoto | Conecta. Construye. Remoto.', description switches to ES, <html lang>=es
verifications.subpages_unique_meta: PASS — /talent-portal, /client-hub, /security-charter, /terms, /privacy all render (lazy InfoPage), each has unique title, unique description, canonical=https://ashtor.net/<slug>
verifications.admin_noindex: PASS — /admin loads (lazy Admin), title='Command Center | ashtor.net', meta[name=robots]='noindex, nofollow', login form visible
verifications.footer_seo_block: PASS — [data-testid=footer-seo-block] visible on landing with heading + ~110 word paragraph; content switches to Spanish when ES selected ('Reclutamiento tech remoto, bien hecho')
verifications.regression_landing: PASS — hero, counter, LinkedIn/GitHub connect cards, stats, footer all render; chat-widget-button appears (lazy ChatWidget) and opens panel on click; 6 form inputs on landing; no pageerrors

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: usePageMeta only creates og:title/og:description but not og:url or og:type per-route; index.html has static defaults which is acceptable but could be enhanced.
Minor: Console shows repeated 401 errors from a background API call on every page load (likely admin session probe). Not related to SEO fixes but worth investigating to reduce console noise.
test_credentials: admin@ashtor.net / AshtorAdmin#2026 (not used — did not perform admin login per instructions to avoid destructive actions)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 7 SEO items from review request verified. If future iterations need language switching validation, use data-testid='language-toggle-es' / 'language-toggle-en'. Sub-pages (InfoPage) do NOT render a <footer> — use wait_for_selector on a page-specific element or just wait_for_timeout after domcontentloaded. Chat widget testid is 'chat-widget-button'.
